task.title: Reject Unicode format controls in tool labels
task.objective: Prevent zero-width and bidirectional Unicode format controls from entering gateway-provided transcript labels
acceptance_criteria: Unicode category Cf is rejected in tool labels
Representative zero-width and bidirectional controls fail before transcript mutation
Existing printable Unicode and exact-length label behavior remains unchanged

attempts.summary: Extended label regressions with representative zero-width and bidirectional format controls
attempts.diagnostic: The focused test did not signal an error for a format-control-bearing label

attempts.summary: Added Cf to the centralized rejected Unicode label categories

outcome.summary: Tool labels now reject invisible and direction-changing format controls before transcript insertion

Central Unicode-category predicates reduce gaps between related display-safety checks
